attr.title: Gunslugs 3 Rogue Tactics
attr.desc: Choose stealth or gunfire as you complete missions through procedurally generated enemy territory.
attr.inst: Install Gunslugs3.zip, then copy your owned gunslugs3.dat into the installed gunslugs3 folder. See gunslugs3.md for supported files and installation steps. Requires compatible 64-bit ARM firmware and PortMaster Java 17 and Westonpack runtimes.
